alerts.title: Jammu-Srinagar NH44 open only for light vehicles; trucks restricted to alternate days at Ramban-Banihal
alerts.summary: After being fully shut multiple times since a July 28 landslide near Dewal Bridge in Udhampur's Samroli area, NH-44 has partially reopened: Traffic Police is allowing light motor vehicles (LMVs) from both sides in daytime only, while heavy motor vehicles (HMVs) — the trucks carrying freight — are restricted to alternate days between Ramban and Banihal due to ongoing road construction, shooting-stone risk and Amarnath Yatra convoy movement.
alerts.impact: Effective truck-capacity halving on the only road link to the Kashmir Valley: expect continued multi-day TAT breaches for Srinagar, Baramulla, Anantnag and Budgam hubs even though light traffic is moving. Schedule linehaul only on HMV-permitted days, hold NS flags for Valley pincodes on off-days, and keep Jammu-hub buffer stock topped up through mid-August.

alerts.title: Kinnaur cloudbursts hit Kachrang, Thach & Mastan villages, sweep away vehicles
alerts.summary: A cloudburst-triggered flash flood in Kachrang village (Nathpa area, Kinnaur) damaged drinking-water schemes and apple orchards, while a separate cloudburst hit Thach village, sweeping away vehicles and damaging houses, with nearby Mastan village losing part of a cowshed and several orchards. Himachal's monsoon death toll now stands near 424 since June 20, with Kullu and Kinnaur worst hit.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Kinnaur/Shimla-Rampur corridor: expect intermittent NH5 (Hindustan-Tibet Road) closures feeding into Reckong Peo/Rampur pincodes. Keep alternate LM routing on standby and relax SLA penalties for Kinnaur-district deliveries during active rain spells.

alerts.title: Char Dham Yatra route landslides at Kedarnath (Munkatiya) and Badrinath (Bhanerpani) highways remain a recurring risk
alerts.summary: The Char Dham Yatra was suspended for two days after continuous rain triggered landslides — debris blocked the Kedarnath Highway near Munkatiya and the Badrinath National Highway near Bhanerpani. Traffic has since resumed, but the same stretches remain vulnerable to repeat blockage with over 45 lakh pilgrims having visited the shrines in 2026 to date.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Rudraprayag/Chamoli hill routes: expect intermittent closures on the Rishikesh-Badrinath and Sonprayag-Kedarnath stretches through August; build extra transit time for hill-town pincodes and avoid scheduling firm delivery slots during active rain alerts.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra: goods-vehicle ban on Delhi-Haridwar highway & Ganga Canal road through Aug 12
alerts.summary: As part of Kanwar Yatra 2026 (Jul 30-Aug 11), all vehicle movement is banned on the Ganga Canal road and Delhi-Haridwar Highway from Aug 4-12; heavy vehicles have been restricted on these routes since Jul 30. In Delhi, goods vehicles bound for UP/Uttarakhand are barred from Ring Road approaches via Shastri Park, Khajuri and Bhajanpura, with diversions via Wazirabad, Vikas Marg, GT Road, Pusta Road and Loni Road.
alerts.impact: Direct FM/LM route restriction — Delhi/Meerut/Haridwar corridor: reroute goods linehaul via the Deoband-Pachenda-Mirapur-Mawana diversion until Aug 12; build 1-2 day buffer for Haridwar/Meerut/Muzaffarnagar-bound dispatches and avoid the Ring Road-to-Shastri Park approach entirely for HTVs.

alerts.title: Kerala red alert: landslides shut Kochi-Dhanushkodi NH near Adimali, Nadukani-Parappanangadi SH fully closed
alerts.summary: Heavy rain triggered landslides across Idukki and Kottayam, killing at least 15 with 7 missing. A landslide near Machiplavu in Adimali blocked the Kochi-Dhanushkodi NH; Moolamattom-Vagamon, Vagamon-Ettumanoor, Vagamon-Upputhara and Kattappana-Vazhavara roads are all blocked, and the Nadukani-Parappanangadi State Highway in Malappuram district is fully closed. IMD has issued a red alert for Idukki and orange alerts for 10 other districts.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Idukki/Kottayam/Malappuram: flag NS for Adimali, Vagamon, Kattappana and Nadukani-linked pincodes until roads reopen. Reroute Kochi-hub linehaul away from the Adimali stretch and build 2-3 day buffer for Malappuram deliveries dependent on the Parappanangadi highway.

alerts.title: Landslide between Edakumari-Shribagilu (Sakleshpur, Hassan) halts 7 trains; Kodagu bridges submerged
alerts.summary: A landslide between Edakumari and Shribagilu stations in Hassan district's Sakleshpur taluk damaged tracks, suspending 7 trains linking Bengaluru with Mangaluru, Karwar, Kozhikode, Murudeshwar and Vijayapura. Several low-lying bridges across Kodagu are submerged, cutting village connectivity, and a hillock collapse killed 3 people (incl. a 3-year-old) in Thirthahalli taluk, Shivamogga. Agumbe recorded 197mm rain in 24 hours.
alerts.impact: Watch list — Malnad belt: Sakleshpur/Kodagu/Chikkamagaluru village-level LM routes face washout risk from submerged bridges; hold NS flags for low-lying Kodagu pincodes and monitor Mangaluru-Bengaluru rail-dependent cargo for delays via alternate road linehaul.

alerts.title: South India truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD mandate grounds 6 lakh+ vehicles in Karnataka alone
alerts.summary: The threatened indefinite strike by truck owners' associations across six southern states went ahead from August 1 over mandatory Vehicle Location Tracking Device (VLTD)/panic-button rules, toll hikes and compliance costs. Karnataka has been hit hardest, with over 6 lakh lorries off the road disrupting supply chains; the South India Motor Transport Association says close to 24 lakh lorries across the south are participating, with no resolution reported as of Aug 4.
alerts.impact: FM linehaul stoppages out of Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hubs are cascading into last-mile delays across tier-2/3 towns dependent on these routes. Activate alternate 3P LM partners where available, pre-position 5-7 days buffer stock, and prepare SLA-relaxation comms for southern pincodes until the strike is resolved.

alerts.title: Landslide at Chandsaili Ghat, Nandurbar, blocks Taloda-Dhadgaon route
alerts.summary: Continuous heavy rain triggered a landslide at Chandsaili Ghat in Nandurbar district, with rocks and debris blocking the Taloda-Dhadgaon route. No casualties reported; local administration is clearing debris to restore traffic.
alerts.impact: Localized watch — Nandurbar tribal belt: expect short-term NS flags for Dhadgaon-side villages until the ghat road reopens; low volume but hard-to-reroute terrain, so extend TAT rather than attempt alternate LM diversion.

alerts.title: South Gujarat floods: Valsad records 100cm rain in 24h, 1,201 roads shut across 138 talukas
alerts.summary: South Gujarat is facing severe flooding with Valsad recording over 100cm of rain in 24 hours; IMD has issued fresh red alerts for multiple districts. Navsari and Surat are seeing rising river levels, NDRF has been deployed, and state-wide 1,201 roads across 138 talukas are closed. Authorities are closely monitoring the Damanganga and Purna rivers.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk — Valsad/Navsari/Surat rural belt: hold NS flags for taluka-level pincodes on the closed-road list; pre-position buffer stock at Surat hub and expect multi-day non-adherence for Damanganga/Purna-adjacent villages.

alerts.title: Bay of Bengal system makes landfall near south Odisha-north AP coast; red alert in Sundargarh, Keonjhar, Mayurbhanj
alerts.summary: A Bay of Bengal low-pressure system made landfall near the south Odisha-north Andhra Pradesh coast, prompting a fishing suspension advisory and danger signal no. 3 at Odisha ports, then tracked west-northwest across northern Odisha into Gangetic West Bengal. IMD has issued a red alert for Sundargarh, Keonjhar and Mayurbhanj (14 districts orange, 13 yellow) with widespread heavy rain expected through Aug 10; separately, North Bengal's hill and dooars belt — Darjeeling, Jalpaiguri, Kalimpong, Alipurduar and Coochbehar — is under a heavy-to-very-heavy rain watch (7-20cm) through Aug 5.
alerts.impact: Watch list — coastal Odisha/north AP ports plus inland Odisha/WB and North Bengal hills: fishing-port linked FM pickups remain paused; pre-flag Bhubaneswar/Rourkela-hub dispatches into Sundargarh/Keonjhar/Mayurbhanj as at-risk, and keep alternate hill routing on standby for Siliguri-hub deliveries into Darjeeling/Kalimpong through Aug 10.

alerts.title: Assam floods: death toll hits 87, Sivasagar and Charaideo worst-hit among 437 villages submerged
alerts.summary: Assam's flood death toll has risen to 87 (2 more deaths reported Aug 4) with nearly 1.3 lakh people still affected across 437 villages in 21 revenue circles spanning Golaghat, Sivasagar, Biswanath, Charaideo, Kamrup Metropolitan, Jorhat, Dhemaji and Nagaon districts. Sivasagar alone accounts for 47 deaths and Charaideo 21, with Jorhat (9), Dhemaji (3), Golaghat (3), Karbi Anglong (2), Sonitpur (1) and Kamrup (1) also hit. Over 11,000 people remain in relief camps.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — Sivasagar/Charaideo/Golaghat/Dhemaji/Nagaon rural pincodes: maintain NS flags for the worst-hit revenue circles; coordinate with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate Guwahati-hub routing and expect extended TAT for Sivasagar/Charaideo deliveries through mid-August.

alerts.title: Brahmaputra erosion eats into Chabua, Balijan, Dinjan (Dibrugarh) and Bilasipara villages; IIT-Guwahati roped in
alerts.summary: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma toured erosion-hit Chabua, Balijan, Pukhurijan, Dinjan and Rahmoria villages in Dibrugarh district on Aug 3 and announced IIT-Guwahati will design a long-term anti-erosion strategy. Separately, erosion has continued for nearly a month in Roumari Pathar (Barpeta district) and in Bilasipara villages — Kamarpara, Kandhapara, Boaler char, Babupara and Chenger Algah — displacing hundreds of families as the river keeps shifting course.
alerts.impact: Villages losing land to the Brahmaputra in Dibrugarh, Barpeta and Bilasipara are high non-adherence risk for LM — access roads and address landmarks used for last-mile delivery can shift or vanish within weeks. Flag these panchayats for recurring serviceability review rather than a one-time NS tag, and cross-check addresses against relief-camp relocations before dispatch.

alerts.title: Imphal-Jiribam NH-37 in Manipur's Noney district hit by fresh landslides; NE rail link via Haflong also disrupted
alerts.summary: Torrential rain triggered fresh landslides on NH-37 between Imphal and Jiribam in Manipur's Noney district — a corridor that has seen repeated cut-offs through this monsoon. The same spell disrupted train services to Tripura, Manipur and Mizoram via the Haflong section, and separately blocked NH-2 near Lunglei in Mizoram, forcing evacuations in both states.
alerts.impact: Treat Noney-district NH-37 as a chronic risk corridor for FM into Imphal — pre-stage buffer stock at Imphal/Jiribam and avoid single-route dependency for NE dispatches through August. Watch for repeat rail disruption via Haflong affecting any rail-linked linehaul into Tripura/Mizoram.

alerts.title: Sikkim: 7th Mile landslide near Kyongnosla on JN Road active 2+ weeks, 65-67 families displaced
alerts.summary: A massive, still-active landslide at 7th Mile under Kyongnosla village on the Jawaharlal Nehru (JN) Road near the Indo-China border has washed away a 200-metre road stretch and displaced 65-67 families, who remain in relief camps. The route is strategically important, serving several Army camps along the border.
alerts.impact: Watch list — North Sikkim border belt: JN Road-dependent pincodes near Kyongnosla should carry extended NS flags; this is a low-volume but zero-alternate-route corridor, so plan for prolonged non-adherence rather than rerouting.

alerts.title: Ganga erosion swallows homes in Jawainiya village, Shahpur block, Bhojpur
alerts.summary: Ongoing Ganga riverbank erosion in Jawainiya village (Shahpur block, Bhojpur district) has collapsed over 100 homes, with over 100 families fearing they will lose theirs next. District administration has approved a township/rehabilitation plan for 165 affected families after a sanctioned ₹9.8 crore embankment ('thokar') was not completed in time.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss — Shahpur block, Bhojpur: flag Jawainiya and adjoining riverside villages as NS/high-risk for LM delivery; expect displaced-household address mismatches feeding non-adherence — verify addresses against relief-camp locations before dispatch.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel unchanged, but commercial LPG cut ~₹200/cylinder from Aug 1
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain unchanged despite the recent crude oil drop — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20/litre, Kolkata & Chennai ₹113.05/₹97.80/litre. Commercial (19kg) LPG cylinders got cheaper by ₹192-209 across major cities from Aug 1 for the second straight month; domestic (14.2kg) LPG is unchanged for a second month running.
alerts.impact: Cost watch, no action yet: petrol/diesel stability keeps 3P per-km rates stable for now; the commercial-LPG cut has no direct fleet impact but signals softening energy costs — track weekly for early signal on Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees fuel surcharge negotiations ahead of the next pricing cycle.
